Method of Attack: Hijacking abandoned S3 bucket to replace binaries with malicious ones
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious binaries stealing user IDs, passwords, environment variables, and local hostnames

Method of Attack: Hijacking abandoned email domains to reset repository passwords and inject malicious code
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious code targeting environment variables, particularly AWS credentials

Method of Attack: Hijacking abandoned package names to inject malicious content
Impacted Systems: Projects using the 'gemnasium-gitlab-service' gem without updating dependencies

Method of Attack: Subdomain hijacking to host malicious content
Hijacking abandoned Java and Android libraries by acquiring expired domain names linked to these libraries
Impacted Systems: Maven-based technologies, including Gradle, and projects from companies like Google, Facebook, Amazon, Microsoft, Adobe, LinkedIn, Netflix
